zh.d: 了解 OpenMousse 的核心组件、数据归属与运行边界。
zh.x: 主对话里的会议纪要，和手机上的「今天」 OpenMousse 是开源的个人 AI agent 系统（AGPL-3.0）。你的对话、日常数据、工作与学习资料以及好友间的讨论均保存在只属于你的服务器上，从中提炼的事实、偏好、决定与成熟的观点沉淀为长期记忆（世界树）。多个功能 Agent 在此基础上，按你原有的工作方式负责安排、提醒与代办。 系统运行在你的自有服务器上，也可以运行在我们即将开放的托管专属云服务器上（可在官网首页加入等候名单）。客户端提供 iPhone（TestFlight 邀请）、Android（安装包）与网页版；电脑端（网页工作台与 Mac 客户端）即将推出。 你会得到什么 可查阅、可修改的世界树。 每一条关于你的事实、偏好、决定与观点都存为一片带出处的叶子，标明来自哪一次对话、哪一天。你可以随时查看、修改或删除，也可以将其存为 Markdown 笔记放入自己的笔记库。 跨 AI 应用共用的长期记忆。 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、Notion 与 Claude Code 可通过各自的专属地址接入世界树，回答前先调取你的背景，并将新信息写回世界树，不再各存一份。 职责分明的功能 Agent 与会议。 主对话是总入口，负责把事务转交给健身、饮食、睡眠、代办、学习与办公等功能 Agent，或召集它们开短会并出具纪要；每个功能 Agent 拥有独立的记忆、工具与看板（支持表格、看板、日历、时间线、图表五种视图）。 先放下想法的 Zen。 刚读完的文章或一闪而过的念头可以先存入 Zen，只存不发，AI 不会介入；准备好之后再挑出相关内容点「讨论」一起推敲，点「完成」整理并「保存到库」，成熟的观点写入世界树。 撤不回的操作先问你。 付款、对外发送、提交、登录等操作一律先停下来，生成锁定参数的确认卡放入收件箱与今天页的「待处理」，等你批准后才执行。 隔离的代办沙箱与 Doorman。 代办 Agent 在隔离的沙箱中打开网页、比价、填表与预订；密码由 Doorman 保管，代办只拿到占位符，请求离开服务器的那一刻才换成真值并发往绑定的网站。 有边界的好友互动与管家。 好友消息经签名并端到端加密；对外分享的讨论先逐条遮盖隐私；管家按亲近、朋友、同学三档关系回答忙闲与近况，看不到世界树与健康数据，涉及时间、金钱、承诺的事一律生成确认卡交给你定。 长期辅助思考的赛博 [即将推出]。 赛博拥有独立的性格、记忆与模型，在特定方向上长期辅助你思考；它不直接访问你的数据，查资料或改动数据均交由其装载的功能 Agent 处理。 提示：OpenMousse 的边界与承诺 OpenMousse 不会在未经你确认的情况下对外发信、付款或承诺时间。我们不投放广告，不出售数据，不用你的数据训练模型。每一轮对话发往你所选模型服务（包括备用模型）的内容，仅限该轮消息与回答所需的记忆；其余记忆与文件均留在你的服务器上。 开发者与架构 OpenMousse 采用自研的 Python 内核（agent harness）[即将推出] 管理模型调用、上下文与工具权限分档。如果你希望了解发言方权限回合、通过兼容 OpenAI 的 API 或 ACP 协议调用系统，或查看源码结构，请参阅「内核（agent harness）」与 GitHub 仓库（github.com/openmousse/openmousse）。

en.d: Learn about OpenMousse's core components, data ownership model, and operating boundaries.
en.x: Meeting minutes in main chat and Today on a phone OpenMousse is an open-source personal AI agent system (AGPL-3.0). Your conversations, daily data, study and work materials, and discussions with friends stay on a server that belongs to you. Facts, preferences, decisions, and distilled opinions from those interactions settle into long-term memory (the memory tree). Built on that foundation, functional agents handle scheduling, reminders, and errands around the way you already work. The system runs on your own server or on a dedicated cloud server hosted by OpenMousse (opening soon; join the waitlist on the home page). Clients are available for iPhone (via TestFlight invitation), Android (APK installer), and the web app; desktop clients (a web workspace and a Mac app) are coming soon. What You Get An inspectable, editable memory tree. Every fact, preference, decision, and opinion about you is stored as a provenance-tracked leaf recording which conversation and which day it came from. You can view, edit, or delete any leaf at any time, or store leaves as Markdown notes in your own vault. Long-term memory shared across AI apps. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Notion, and Claude Code connect to the memory tree through dedicated URLs, retrieving your background before answering and writing new information back to the memory tree instead of keeping separate copies. Functional agents with clear boundaries and short meetings. Main chat is the single entry point that routes tasks to functional agents such as Fitness, Diet, Sleep, Errands, and Study & Work, or calls them into a short meeting and produces minutes; each functional agent has its own memory, tools, and board (supporting table, kanban, calendar, timeline, and chart views). Zen for setting thoughts down first. Articles you just read or fleeting thoughts go into Zen as notes without sending—no AI steps in; when you are ready, pick related items to Discuss together, tap Done to organize them, and Save to the vault while distilled opinions are written to the memory tree. Approval before irreversible actions. Payments, outbound messages, submissions, and logins always pause and generate a parameter-locked approval card in the inbox and under To do in Today, executing only after you approve. An isolated Errands sandbox and Doorman. The Errands agent opens web pages, compares prices, fills forms, and books inside an isolated sandbox; Doorman holds your passwords and gives Errands only placeholders, swapping in the real values only at the moment a request leaves the server for its bound domain. Bounded friend interactions and the Butler. Friend messages are signed and end-to-end encrypted; shared discussions have private details redacted item by item first; the Butler answers availability and status questions across three relationship tiers (close, friend, acquaintance), cannot see the memory tree or health data, and turns anything involving time, money, or commitments into an approval card for you to decide. Cybers for long-term thinking [Coming soon]. Each Cyber has its own personality, memory, and model to assist your thinking in a specific direction over the long term; a Cyber never accesses your data directly and delegates any data lookup or change to the functional agents mounted on it. Note: OpenMousse's Boundaries and Commitments OpenMousse never sends external messages, makes payments, or commits your time without your confirmation. OpenMousse serves no ads, sells no data, and never trains models on your data. On each turn of a conversation, only that turn's message and the memories needed to answer are sent to your chosen model provider (including any fallback model); all other memories and files remain on your server. Developers and Architecture OpenMousse uses an in-house Python engine (agent harness) [Coming soon] to manage model calls, context, and tiered tool permissions. To learn about speaker permission turns, calling the system via the OpenAI-compatible API or ACP protocol, or the source layout, see Engine (Agent Harness) and the GitHub repository (github.com/openmousse/openmousse).

zh.d: 部署 OpenMousse，配对手机或网页端，导入记忆并完成第一次交办。
h: 方式 A：在自己的服务器上安装
方式 B：让已有的 agent 安装
3. 设置记忆与连接健康数据
zh.x: 本页带你从零完成服务器安装（或经由已有 agent 接入）、配对客户端、导入已有记忆，并发出第一个请求。 提示：按任务查阅指南 如果你只需要把 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini 等常用 AI 接进世界树，或只想单独安装世界树服务，请直接前往指南「把你常用的 AI 接进世界树」或「仅安装世界树服务」。如果你希望加入托管服务器的等候名单，可在官网首页留下邮箱。 系统要求 服务器：一台长期开机的 Linux、macOS，或 Windows WSL 2 机器。 基础依赖：Python 3.11 以上版本、git、curl。 网络：服务器与手机可加入同一个 Tailscale 虚拟局域网，或服务器具备公网 HTTPS 地址。 客户端：iPhone（经 TestFlight 邀请安装）、Android（使用安装包）、网页版，以及电脑端 [即将推出]。 1. 安装 OpenMousse 你可以选择在自己的服务器上直接运行安装命令，或把一段指令发给正在运行的外部 agent 由它完成安装。 方式 A：在自己的服务器上安装 在服务器终端运行以下命令： curl -fsSL https://openmousse.ai/install | bash 按终端提示依次设置语言、时区、助手名称与运行方式（直接配置所用模型 [即将推出]）。安装结束时，终端会显示客户端配对码。随后将服务器加入 Tailscale，或配置公网 HTTPS，使手机能够访问服务器。 方式 B：让已有的 agent 安装 如果你已经在运行 OpenClaw 或 Hermes，将以下指令复制并发送给它： 按 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openmousse/openmousse/main/docs/connect.zh-CN.md 把我接上 OpenMousse 该 agent 会依次检查机器环境、开启本机对话接口、配置 Tailscale、非交互安装 OpenMousse、为自己接入 board、inbox、goals、journal 等工具，并运行 bash ~/openmousse/check.sh 自检；在需要 sudo、安装 Tailscale 或开放公网前会先停下来等你确认。完成后，它会向你发送一条有效期 10 分钟的一次性配对链接。 2. 配对客户端 使用配对码（方式 A）：在手机上打开 OpenMousse app 或打开网页版，输入终端显示的配对码完成连接。 使用一次性配对链接（方式 B）：确认手机已安装 Tailscale（登录与服务器相同的账号）及 OpenMousse app。在手机上点开配对链接，app 将打开连接页并自动填入服务器地址与配对码；核对地址无误后，点击「使用配对码连接」。你也可以手动将链接或 8 位配对码粘贴至连接页完成连接。 3. 设置记忆与连接健康数据 导入已有记忆：你可以将 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等外部 AI 记得的关于你的事贴进主对话，由主对话写进世界树；或者在 app 中打开「设置 → 世界树 → 连接你的 AI」，为它们生成专属地址直接接入世界树。 连接健康数据：在 iPhone 上可连接 Apple 健康（Android Health Connect [即将推出]），供睡眠 Agent 与健身 Agent 读取睡眠、心率与训练数据。 提示：默认边界 数据在你的手机和你的服务器之间传输；每一轮对话发往你所选模型服务的，是这一轮的消息和回答所需的内容。手动授权接入世界树的外部 AI 应用仅能读写世界树，无法读取你的对话记录、健康数据及各功能 Agent 的独立记忆。 4. 发出第一个请求 打开「主对话」，你可以直接尝试以下请求： 写入与调取记忆：「记住我对花生过敏，平时早上只喝黑咖啡。」 建立功能 Agent：「帮我建一个研究 Agent，专门整理行业报告和纪要。」（主对话会生成一张方案卡，经你确认后建立该 Agent。） 召集多个 Agent 开短会（建好睡眠、健身、饮食 Agent 以后可以试）：「这周末我要出差两天，睡眠、健身和饮食怎么调整？」（主对话会召集对应 Agent 讨论并出具会议纪要卡，你确认后待办才会写入日程与各 Agent 的看板。） 交办代办事务：「帮我比价下周三去往目的地的高铁与航班，把候选方案列出来。」（查询与比价在沙箱内完成；涉及提交或付款时，会停下来生成确认卡放入收件箱。） 5. 继续探索 把你常用的 AI 接进世界树：为 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、Notion 与 Claude Code 配置世界树 MCP 地址。 世界树：了解叶子、出处记录、SQLite 与 Markdown 笔记库存储方式。 Agents：了解主对话、功能 Agent、会议纪要、赛博与管家的分工。 先问你（收件箱）：了解工具分档、参数锁定与确认卡的审批流程。 提示：版本更新与故障自检 需要更新服务器版本时，重新运行安装命令 curl -fsSL https://openmousse.ai/install | bash 即可拉取最新代码、补齐缺失组件并重启服务，原有数据保持不变。遇到运行故障时，在服务器上运行 bash ~/openmousse/check.sh，终端会逐项显示 ✓ 或 ✗ 及修复方法；输出不含任何令牌与密钥。

en.d: Deploy OpenMousse, pair your phone or web client, import memory, and run your first request.
h: Option A: Install on Your Own Server
Option B: Have an Existing Agent Install It
3. Set Up Memory and Connect Health Data
en.x: This page walks you through installing the server from scratch (or connecting through an existing agent), pairing a client, importing existing memories, and sending your first request. Note: Jump to a Task-Specific Guide If you only want to connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or other external AIs to the memory tree, or only want to run the standalone memory tree service, go directly to Connect Your AIs to the Memory Tree or Install the Standalone Memory Tree. To join the waitlist for a hosted server, leave your email on the home page. System Requirements Server: An always-on Linux, macOS, or Windows WSL 2 machine. Base dependencies: Python 3.11 or later, git, and curl. Network: The server and your phone on the same Tailscale tailnet, or a public HTTPS URL on the server. Client: iPhone (installed via TestFlight invitation), Android (APK installer), the web app, and desktop clients [Coming soon]. 1. Install OpenMousse You can run the install command directly on your own server, or send a one-line prompt to a running external agent and let it complete the installation. Option A: Install on Your Own Server Run the following command in your server terminal: curl -fsSL https://openmousse.ai/install | bash Follow the terminal prompts to set your language, time zone, assistant name, and runtime (selecting your model directly [Coming soon]). When installation finishes, the terminal displays a client pairing code. Next, join the server to Tailscale or configure public HTTPS so your phone can reach it. Option B: Have an Existing Agent Install It If you already run OpenClaw or Hermes, copy and send the following prompt to it: Connect me to OpenMousse following https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openmousse/openmousse/main/docs/connect.md The agent checks the machine environment, enables the local chat endpoint, configures Tailscale, runs a non-interactive OpenMousse install, wires tools such as board, inbox, goals, and journal into itself, and runs bash ~/openmousse/check.sh to self-check; it pauses for your confirmation before using sudo, installing Tailscale, or exposing anything to the public internet. When finished, it sends you a one-time pairing link valid for 10 minutes. 2. Pair Your Client With a pairing code (Option A): Open the OpenMousse app on your phone or open the web app, and enter the pairing code shown in the terminal to connect. With a one-time pairing link (Option B): Make sure your phone has Tailscale installed (signed in to the same account as the server) along with the OpenMousse app. Tap the pairing link on your phone; the app opens the connection screen with the server address and pairing code filled in. Verify the address and tap Connect with code. You can also paste the link or the 8-character pairing code into the connection screen manually. 3. Set Up Memory and Connect Health Data Import existing memories: Paste what external AIs such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini remember about you into Main chat so main chat can write it into the memory tree; or open Settings → Memory tree → Connect your AI in the app to generate dedicated URLs that connect those AIs directly to the memory tree. Connect health data: On iPhone, connect Apple Health (Android Health Connect [Coming soon]) so the Sleep agent and Fitness agent can read sleep, heart rate, and workout data. Note: Default Boundaries Data travels between your phone and your server; on each turn of a conversation, what goes to your chosen model provider is that turn's message and the content needed to answer. External AI apps that you manually authorize to access the memory tree can only read and write the memory tree; they cannot read your conversation history, health data, or the independent memories of your functional agents. 4. Send Your First Request Open Main chat and try any of the following requests: Write and recall memory: "Remember that I'm allergic to peanuts and only drink black coffee in the morning." Create a functional agent: "Create a Research agent for me that organizes industry reports and meeting notes." (Main chat generates a proposal card and creates the agent once you confirm.) Call multiple agents into a short meeting (try this after creating the Sleep, Fitness, and Diet agents): "I'm traveling for work for two days this weekend—how should my sleep, workouts, and meals adjust?" (Main chat calls the relevant agents into a discussion and produces a meeting minutes card; action items are written to Schedule and each agent's board only after you confirm.) Hand off an errand: "Compare high-speed rail and flight options to my destination for next Wednesday and list the candidates." (Search and price comparison run inside the sandbox; if anything involves submitting a form or paying, it stops and places an approval card in the inbox.) 5. Next Steps Connect Your AIs to the Memory Tree: Configure memory tree MCP URLs for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Notion, and Claude Code. Memory Tree: Learn about leaves, provenance tracking, and SQLite versus Markdown vault storage. Agents: Understand how main chat, functional agents, meeting minutes, Cybers, and the Butler divide work. Approvals (Inbox): Learn how tool tiers, parameter locking, and approval cards work. Note: Updates and Self-Checks To update your server, re-run curl -fsSL https://openmousse.ai/install | bash to pull the latest code, install any missing components, and restart services while keeping all existing data intact. If something is not working, run bash ~/openmousse/check.sh on the server; the terminal shows ✓ or ✗ for each check along with the fix command, and the output never contains tokens or keys.

zh.d: 拉取最新代码更新服务器，或运行 `check.sh` 排查运行故障。
h: 3. 单独检查世界树笔记（mousse-tree check）
zh.x: 本页说明如何将 OpenMousse 服务器（及单独安装的世界树服务）更新至最新版本，以及在连接中断或工具异常时如何使用自检脚本排查故障。 1. 更新 OpenMousse 服务器 在运行 OpenMousse 的服务器终端中，重新执行安装命令： curl -fsSL https://openmousse.ai/install | bash 安装程序会自动拉取最新代码、补齐缺失的组件与依赖，并重启系统服务。 数据保留：你的对话记录、世界树记忆、各功能 Agent 的独立记忆与看板数据、已配对设备的令牌均保持不变，无需重新配对客户端。 单独安装的世界树服务：如果你仅安装了 mousse-tree 而未部署完整的 OpenMousse，请使用 pipx upgrade openmousse-tree（或重新运行 pip install --user --upgrade "git+https://github.com/openmousse/openmousse#subdirectory=tree"）更新代码，随后重启 mousse-tree 服务。 2. 运行故障自检（check.sh） 当手机 app 无法连接服务器、模型未响应或 MCP 工具调用失败时，在服务器终端运行自检脚本： bash ~/openmousse/check.sh 脚本会逐项检查以下十个部分，并在每一项前显示 ✓（正常）或 ✗（异常）以及对应的修复命令： 系统、版本和仓库； OpenMousse 服务； 手机怎么连（Tailscale）； 你的 claw； 模型能不能回话； MCP 入口； 世界树； 分享和好友（中继）； 每晚日结和推送设备； 磁盘剩余。 提示：自检输出不含密钥 check.sh 的输出不会包含任何令牌、API 密钥或配置文件中的敏感字段（如 ~/.openmousse/server.json、openclaw.json 或 .env 的内容）。你可以直接复制终端输出，交由协助排查的人员或你正在使用的外部 agent 查看。 3. 单独检查世界树笔记（mousse-tree check） 如果你将世界树配置为 Markdown 笔记文件夹存储（例如与 Obsidian 同步的目录），并在外部编辑器中手动修改过笔记，可以运行以下命令检查笔记格式： mousse-tree check 检查损坏的属性：命令会列出属性（front matter）格式有误的笔记。格式损坏的笔记会被检索跳过，其余笔记照常工作；修复后服务会自动重新收录。 手动重建索引：在 Markdown 存储模式下，服务每 5 秒自动检测文件变更并更新 index.db 检索索引。如需立即全量重建索引，可运行： mousse-tree rebuild 4. 常见情况说明 更换模型是否影响记忆：不会。世界树与各功能 Agent 的记忆均保存在你的服务器上，与所选模型服务无关。 Hermes 接入过程中的 ✗ 提示：如果你正由聊天窗口内的 Hermes Agent 自动安装 OpenMousse，在你在聊天中发送 /restart 重启网关之前，check.sh 中「你的 claw」一项显示 ✗ 属于正常现象；重启网关后再次运行 check.sh 即会变为 ✓。 另见 快速开始：查看初次安装与配对流程。 让正在运行的 agent 安装 OpenMousse：查看外部 agent 自动安装与排查的步骤。 仅安装世界树服务：查看 mousse-tree 的独立维护命令。

en.d: Update your server with the latest code or run `check.sh` to diagnose issues.
h: 3. Check Memory Tree Notes Directly (mousse-tree check)
en.x: This page explains how to update an OpenMousse server (and a standalone memory tree installation) to the latest release, and how to run the self-check script when connections drop or tools fail. 1. Update the OpenMousse Server In the terminal on the server running OpenMousse, re-run the install command: curl -fsSL https://openmousse.ai/install | bash The installer pulls the latest code, installs any missing components or dependencies, and restarts the system services. Data preservation: Your conversation history, memory tree leaves, functional agents' independent memories and boards, and paired device tokens all remain intact; you do not need to re-pair your clients. Standalone memory tree service: If you only installed mousse-tree without deploying the full OpenMousse system, run pipx upgrade openmousse-tree (or re-run pip install --user --upgrade "git+https://github.com/openmousse/openmousse#subdirectory=tree") to update the code, then restart the mousse-tree service. 2. Run the Troubleshooting Self-Check (check.sh) When the mobile app cannot reach the server, the model does not respond, or MCP tool calls fail, run the self-check script in the server terminal: bash ~/openmousse/check.sh The script checks ten areas in order and prints ✓ (healthy) or ✗ (failing) before each item along with the command to fix it: System, version, and repository; OpenMousse service; Phone connectivity (Tailscale); Your claw; Model response check; MCP endpoint; Memory tree; Sharing and friends (relay); Nightly settlement and push devices; Free disk space. Note: Self-Check Output Contains No Secrets The output of check.sh never includes tokens, API keys, or sensitive fields from configuration files (such as ~/.openmousse/server.json, openclaw.json, or .env). You can safely copy and paste the terminal output to share with someone helping you troubleshoot or with your external agent. 3. Check Memory Tree Notes Directly (mousse-tree check) If you configured the memory tree to store leaves as a folder of Markdown notes (for example, a folder synced with Obsidian) and edited notes in an external editor, run the following command to validate note formatting: mousse-tree check Inspect malformed front matter: The command lists any notes whose front matter is malformed. Malformed notes are skipped during search while all other notes continue to work normally; once fixed, they are automatically indexed again. Rebuild the index manually: In Markdown storage mode, the service detects file changes every 5 seconds and updates the index.db search index automatically. To force an immediate full rebuild of the index, run: mousse-tree rebuild 4. Common Situations Does switching models affect memory? No. Both the memory tree and each functional agent's memory are stored on your server and are independent of the model provider you select. ✗ during Hermes setup: If a Hermes Agent inside a chat window is installing OpenMousse for you, seeing ✗ next to "Your claw" in check.sh before you send /restart in the chat to restart the gateway is expected; re-running check.sh after the gateway restarts will show ✓. See Also Getting Started: Review the initial installation and pairing flow. Install OpenMousse via an Existing Agent: Review the steps for automated installation and troubleshooting through an external agent. Install the Standalone Memory Tree: Review standalone maintenance commands for mousse-tree.

zh.d: 查看正在开发与即将上线的功能模块。

en.d: View features currently in development and upcoming releases.
en.x: This page lists OpenMousse modules that are being merged into the main branch, running on internal instances, or have finalized designs in active development. Modules are grouped by current stage and land in the public repository once testing completes. Note: Release Cadence This page reflects current engineering progress and finalized product designs without fixed release dates. For features that are already live, see the pages under Features and Guides in the sidebar. Merging and Running Internally The following modules are implemented on development branches or running steadily on internal instances and are being prepared for merge into the public main branch: In-house Python engine (agent harness) [Coming soon]: Manages model calls, context, and security rule enforcement. Includes three speaker permission turns (you, a Cyber, and a friend's agent or stranger), three tool execution tiers (read-only runs immediately; reversible runs and returns a change ID that can be rolled back by replying Undo; irreversible pauses and creates a parameter-locked approval card), and automatic fallback to a backup model with a note when the primary model is unavailable. Programmatic API [Coming soon]: Exposes an OpenAI-compatible API and ACP protocol in the engine so code editors and other external programs can call OpenMousse directly as a model. Weekly memory tree pruning [Coming soon]: Checks the memory tree every Sunday for duplicate or near-duplicate leaves, proposes merges or deletions, and applies them item by item after you confirm. Isolated agent-authored pages [Coming soon]: Run inside an isolated environment that cannot read login credentials or other system data and cannot send data externally; opening a page for the first time lists the data items it wants to read and grants read-only access only after you approve, requiring re-approval whenever its code changes. Design Finalized, in Development The following modules have finalized interaction and architecture designs and are under active client or server development: Desktop clients and Android Health Connect: Launching desktop clients (a web workspace and a Mac app), and adding Health Connect support on Android to read sleep, heart rate, and workout data. Hosted dedicated cloud servers: Offering an official hosted cloud server option; you can join the waitlist on the home page now. Memory tab and tree-ring view: Updating the fourth tab in the bottom bar to Memory and moving the memory tree inside it. Adds a tree-ring view where the outer ring is today and inner rings are past dates; each dot is a new memory, and amber dots resting outside the ring are entries waiting for your confirmation. Cybers (long-term thinking companions): Agents with their own personality, memory, and model that assist your thinking in a specific direction over the long term. Each Cyber's profile page is a badge with three sections (Identity, Memory, and Mounts); a Cyber never accesses your data directly, delegates all lookups and actions to the functional agents mounted on it, and requires approval via an approval card before modifying data or writing to the memory tree. The Butler (upgraded from Card agent): Represents you externally and answers questions from friends and friends' Butlers across three relationship tiers (close, friend, acquaintance); reads only the information opened to that tier, cannot see the memory tree or health data, hands anything involving time, money, or commitments to you in person, and has every outbound reply reviewed by Doorman. Interactive agent creation flow: Supports creating a functional agent through a "one-line description → system follow-up questions → pre-filled draft → test chat before finalizing" flow. See Also Welcome to OpenMousse: Learn about the core components and operating boundaries that are live today. Engine (Agent Harness): Learn about speaker permission turns and three-tier tool execution in the engine.

zh.t: 把你常用的 AI 接进世界树
zh.d: 将 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、Notion 与 Claude Code 接入世界树共用同一份长期记忆。
h: 1. 在 app 中获取专属接入地址
2. 在目标平台配置 MCP 连接
3. 粘贴自定义指令并关闭自带记忆
附：如果你只想单独安装世界树
zh.x: 完成本指南后，你常用的外部 AI 应用将通过专属的 MCP 地址连接你的世界树：在每次对话开始前先读取你的背景与偏好，并在你说出关于自己的新事实、偏好、决定或近况时写回世界树。本指南假设你已部署 OpenMousse（或已单独安装 mousse-tree 服务）。 前提条件 已运行 OpenMousse 服务器并完成 app 配对；或者已在拥有 Python 3.11 以上版本的服务器上单独安装了 mousse-tree 服务（见文末补充说明）。 若要接入云端 AI 应用（Claude 网页版、ChatGPT、Gemini、Notion），你的世界树服务必须具备可访问的公网 HTTPS 地址（仅本机使用的命令行工具如 Claude Code 可使用局域网或 Tailscale 地址）。 部分平台有订阅或版本要求：ChatGPT 需 Plus 及以上订阅；Notion 需 Business 及以上版本；Gemini 的连接器功能受服务商的可用地区限制，需在支持该功能的地区使用。 隐私说明 写入与读取的内容：世界树接收的是你在这些 AI 应用中谈及的关于你的事实、偏好、决定与观点；各平台原有的对话记录仍留在原处。 数据隔离边界：授权接入的外部 AI 应用仅能读写世界树，无法读取 OpenMousse 内的对话记录、健康数据及各功能 Agent 的独立记忆。 来源识别与随时撤销：每个平台使用一条带专属令牌的独立地址，服务端凭令牌识别每片叶子的写入来源。你可以在 OpenMousse app 内随时删除任意平台的地址；删除后，世界树服务重启即断开该平台的连接（若世界树以系统服务运行，app 会自动重启它；否则需手动重启服务）。 步骤 1. 在 app 中获取专属接入地址 在 OpenMousse app 中打开「设置 → 世界树 → 连接你的 AI」。 选择你要接入的目标平台，生成并复制该平台带专属令牌的独立地址。 注意：公网 HTTPS 与管理页隔离 Claude（网页版）、ChatGPT、Gemini 与 Notion 均从各自的云端发起连接，因此你的世界树服务必须配置公网 HTTPS。若你使用反向代理对外开放单独安装的 mousse-tree，建议仅对外开放 /t 与 /m 两个路径前缀；请勿将管理页开放至公网。 2. 在目标平台配置 MCP 连接 按你所使用的平台，完成对应的连接配置： 平台 配置路径与操作步骤 Claude 1. 在 claude.ai 打开「设置 → 连接器（Connectors）→ 添加自定义连接器」。 2. 名称填写「世界树」，粘贴 app 中对应的专属地址，认证方式留空。 ChatGPT 1. 在 ChatGPT（需 Plus 及以上订阅）打开「设置 → Apps & Connectors → 高级」，开启 Developer mode。 2. 点击「创建」，粘贴 app 中对应的专属地址，认证方式选择 None。 Gemini 在 gemini.google.com 打开「设置 → Connected Apps → 添加自定义 app」，粘贴 app 中对应的专属地址（需在服务商支持该功能的地区使用）。 Notion 1. 在 Notion（需 Business 及以上版本）打开「Custom Agent → Tools & Access → Custom MCP server」。 2. 填入服务地址，认证方式选择 Bearer token，并将 app 给出的令牌填入对应栏位。 Claude Code 在终端运行以下命令，将 <地址> 替换为 app 中给出的专属地址： claude mcp add --transport http tree <地址> 其他支持 MCP 的 AI 在目标应用的 MCP、连接器或工具设置中，添加远程 MCP 服务（Streamable HTTP），粘贴 app 中对应的专属地址，无需配置认证。若其网页版暂不支持远程 MCP，可使用其命令行工具或任意支持 MCP 的客户端。 3. 粘贴自定义指令并关闭自带记忆 将以下指令复制到已接入应用的自定义指令中（Notion 写入该 Custom Agent 的 Instructions 中；Claude Code 写入项目的 CLAUDE.md 或全局 CLAUDE.md 中）： 对话开始先调 profile 和 recall 了解我；我说出关于自己的新事实、偏好、决定、近况时调 remember。 随后，在该应用的设置中关闭其自带的记忆功能，避免两边记录不一致。 附：如果你只想单独安装世界树 如果你不需要部署完整的 OpenMousse，可以在拥有 Python 3.11 以上版本的服务器上单独运行世界树服务： pipx install "git+https://github.com/openmousse/openmousse#subdirectory=tree" mousse-tree init --name 你的称呼 --tz UTC mousse-tree install-service 第一行也可替换为 pip install --user "git+https://github.com/openmousse/openmousse#subdirectory=tree"。 将 --tz 参数替换为你的实际时区。 服务默认仅监听本机 127.0.0.1:8787。运行 mousse-tree urls 可在终端查看各平台的含令牌地址（请仅在自己的终端内查看）。 成功的标志 当以下各项均成立时，说明接入已生效： 在外部 AI 应用中开启新对话时，它会调用 profile 与 recall 工具读取世界树。 在该应用中告诉它一条关于你的新偏好或近况，它会调用 remember 工具写入。 打开 OpenMousse app 的世界树，可以看到刚才写入的那片新叶子，且出处标明了该外部应用与当天日期。 该外部应用自带的记忆功能已关闭。 下一步 世界树：了解叶子的存储格式、SQLite 与 Markdown 笔记库的切换方式（mousse-tree migrate）。 数据与安全：查看外部应用的隔离机制与服务器数据存储位置。

en.t: Connect Your AIs to the Memory Tree
en.d: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Notion, and Claude Code to share the same long-term memory tree.
h: 1. Get Dedicated Connection URLs in the App
2. Configure the MCP Connection on Each Platform
3. Paste Custom Instructions and Turn Off Built-In Memory
Appendix: Install Only the Standalone Memory Tree
en.x: After completing this guide, your external AI apps will connect to your memory tree through dedicated MCP URLs: at the start of every conversation they read your background and preferences, and whenever you mention a new fact, preference, decision, or update about yourself they write it back to the memory tree. This guide assumes you have already deployed OpenMousse (or installed the standalone mousse-tree service). Prerequisites A running OpenMousse server paired with the app, or a standalone mousse-tree service installed on a server with Python 3.11 or later (see the appendix at the end of this page). To connect cloud AI apps (Claude on the web, ChatGPT, Gemini, Notion), your memory tree service must be reachable at a public HTTPS URL (local command-line tools such as Claude Code can use a LAN or Tailscale address). Plan or region requirements on some platforms: ChatGPT requires a Plus subscription or higher; Notion requires a Business plan or higher; Gemini's connector feature is subject to Google's regional availability and must be used in a supported region. Privacy Notes What is read and written: The memory tree receives facts, preferences, decisions, and opinions about you that come up in those AI apps; the full conversation transcripts in each platform stay where they are. Data isolation boundary: Authorized external AI apps can only read and write the memory tree; they cannot read OpenMousse conversation history, health data, or the independent memories of your functional agents. Source tracking and instant revocation: Each platform uses its own URL with a dedicated token, which the server uses to record the source of every leaf. You can delete any platform's URL in the OpenMousse app at any time; once deleted, restarting the memory tree service disconnects that platform immediately (if the memory tree runs as a system service, the app restarts it automatically; otherwise restart the service manually). Steps 1. Get Dedicated Connection URLs in the App In the OpenMousse app, open Settings → Memory tree → Connect your AI. Select the target platform you want to connect, then generate and copy that platform's dedicated tokenized URL. Important: Public HTTPS and Admin Page Isolation Claude (web), ChatGPT, Gemini, and Notion connect from their own cloud servers, so your memory tree service must be served over public HTTPS. If you expose a standalone mousse-tree instance through a reverse proxy, expose only the /t and /m path prefixes; never expose the admin page to the public internet. 2. Configure the MCP Connection on Each Platform Follow the steps for the platform you are connecting: Platform Configuration Path and Steps Claude 1. On claude.ai, open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector. 2. Set the name to Memory tree, paste the dedicated URL from the app, and leave authentication blank. ChatGPT 1. In ChatGPT (Plus or higher required), open Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced and enable Developer mode. 2. Click Create, paste the dedicated URL from the app, and set authentication to None. Gemini On gemini.google.com, open Settings → Connected Apps → Add custom app and paste the dedicated URL from the app (must be used in a region where the provider supports this feature). Notion 1. In Notion (Business or higher required), open Custom Agent → Tools & Access → Custom MCP server. 2. Enter the server URL, select Bearer token authentication, and paste the token provided by the app into the token field. Claude Code Run the following command in your terminal, replacing <URL> with the dedicated URL from the app: claude mcp add --transport http tree <URL> Other MCP-compatible AIs In the target app's MCP, Connector, or Tools settings, add a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP), paste the dedicated URL from the app, and leave authentication unconfigured. If its web app does not yet support remote MCP, use its CLI or any MCP-compatible client. 3. Paste Custom Instructions and Turn Off Built-In Memory Copy the following instruction into the custom instructions of each connected app (for Notion, put it in the Custom Agent's Instructions; for Claude Code, put it in your project CLAUDE.md or global CLAUDE.md): At the start of a conversation, call profile and recall to learn about me; whenever I state a new fact, preference, decision, or update about myself, call remember. Then turn off the app's built-in memory feature in its settings so the two systems do not drift out of sync. Appendix: Install Only the Standalone Memory Tree If you do not need a full OpenMousse deployment, you can run the memory tree service on its own on any server with Python 3.11 or later: pipx install "git+https://github.com/openmousse/openmousse#subdirectory=tree" mousse-tree init --name YourName --tz UTC mousse-tree install-service You can replace the first line with pip install --user "git+https://github.com/openmousse/openmousse#subdirectory=tree". Replace the --tz value with your actual time zone. By default, the service listens only on 127.0.0.1:8787. Run mousse-tree urls to view the tokenized URLs for each platform in your terminal (view these only inside your own terminal). How to Verify The connection is working when all of the following hold: Starting a new conversation in the external AI app triggers calls to the profile and recall tools to read from the memory tree. Telling the app a new preference or update about yourself triggers a call to the remember tool. Opening the memory tree in the OpenMousse app shows the new leaf with its provenance set to that external app and today's date. The external app's built-in memory feature is turned off. Next Steps Memory Tree: Learn about the leaf format and how to switch between SQLite and a Markdown vault (mousse-tree migrate). Data and Security: Review how external apps are isolated and where data lives on your server.

zh.t: 让正在运行的 agent 安装 OpenMousse
zh.d: 将安装指令发给正在使用的 OpenClaw 或 Hermes，由它完成环境检查、安装、工具接入与配对。
h: 2. 配合 agent 完成环境与网络确认
3. 等待非交互安装与工具接入
zh.x: 完成本指南后，你正在运行的外部 agent（OpenClaw、Hermes Agent、nanobot、Letta Code，或 KimiClaw 等云端托管实例）将在其所在机器上安装 OpenMousse 服务器，把 board、inbox、goals、journal 等工具接入自身，并向你发送一条一次性手机配对链接。本指南假设你已有一台正在运行上述任一 agent 的机器。 前提条件 你正在使用 OpenClaw、Hermes Agent、nanobot 或 Letta Code，且它所在的机器为 Linux、macOS 或 Windows WSL 2。 手机可安装 Tailscale app 与 OpenMousse app，并能与该机器登录同一个 Tailscale 账号（若为无终端的纯云端连接器环境，见文末说明）。 隐私说明 不替代原有 agent：OpenMousse 作为装在原有 agent 旁边的本地服务与手机前台运行，经由本机 OpenAI 兼容接口将你的话转交给它，并通过 MCP 为它提供看板、收件箱与世界树工具。 密钥不进聊天：安装过程中产生的服务器令牌与 API 密钥仅保存在机器本地文件中（如 ~/.openmousse/server.json、openclaw.json、.env）。agent 发给你的只有第 4 步的一次性配对链接（10 分钟内有效）。 关键操作先问你：在需要使用 sudo 安装系统依赖、安装 Tailscale 或将任何路径开放至公网之前，agent 会先停下来征得你的同意。 步骤 1. 发送安装指令 将以下句子复制并发送给你正在使用的 agent： 按 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openmousse/openmousse/main/docs/connect.zh-CN.md 把我接上 OpenMousse 2. 配合 agent 完成环境与网络确认 agent 读取说明后会按顺序执行操作，并用你的语言告知当前进度。遇到以下环节时，请按提示配合： 安装基础依赖：机器需具备 Python 3.11 以上版本、git 与 curl。若缺失且在 Linux 上需要 sudo apt install，agent 会先询问你。 开启本机对话接口： OpenClaw：安装器会自动备份并修改 openclaw.json，无需你操作。 Hermes Agent：修改 ~/.hermes/.env 与执行安装命令时，Hermes 会弹出批准请求（5 分钟内有效），看到后请点击「允许」。 nanobot / Letta Code：agent 会自行启用对应的本地服务端口。 登录 Tailscale：若机器尚未安装或登录 Tailscale，agent 会在征得你同意后安装并运行 tailscale up，随即将生成的登录链接发给你。请在浏览器中打开该链接，登录你自己的 Tailscale 账号。 注意：云端容器环境的限制 若你的 agent 运行在无 sudo、无虚拟网卡且无 systemd 的容器（如部分云端托管容器）中，agent 会改用 Tailscale 用户态网络模式与后台进程启动服务；容器重启后需重新拉起进程。若容器完全不提供终端（仅提供添加 MCP 连接器的设置页），则需在你的另一台机器上部署 OpenMousse。 3. 等待非交互安装与工具接入 agent 会自动传入你的语言、IANA 时区与助手名称，执行非交互安装（MOUSSE_NONINTERACTIVE=1），将 OpenMousse 的 MCP 工具（共 12 个，未装世界树时为 11 个）注册到自己的配置中，并运行 bash ~/openmousse/check.sh 自检。 如果你在聊天窗口中使用 Hermes：agent 自身无法在聊天网关内重启网关。当它完成安装并发出配对链接后，请你在聊天窗口中发送 /restart（或 /reload-mcp），让它完成最后一次 check.sh 核对。 4. 在手机上完成配对 安装通过后，agent 会运行配对脚本并将一条一次性配对链接（link）发给你： 在手机上安装 Tailscale app，登录与第 2 步相同的账号。 在手机上安装并打开 OpenMousse app，点击 agent 发来的配对链接。 app 会打开连接页并自动填入服务器地址与配对码；核对地址无误后，点击「使用配对码连接」（配对码 10 分钟后过期，过期可让 agent 重新生成）。 成功的标志 当以下各项均成立时，说明接入已完成： 服务器上运行 bash ~/openmousse/check.sh 时，所有检查项均显示 ✓。 你的 agent 能够列出 openmousse 下的 12 个 MCP 工具（board、inbox、goals、journal 等）。 手机 OpenMousse app 已通过配对链接连上服务器，在 app 内发送消息可收到该 agent 的回复。 下一步 把你常用的 AI 接进世界树：将 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini 等外部应用也接入同一棵世界树。 给 agent 的安装说明：查看供外部 agent 直接读取的完整命令与环境变量参考。

en.t: Install OpenMousse via an Existing Agent
en.d: Send an install prompt to a running OpenClaw or Hermes instance to verify the environment, install, wire tools, and pair.
h: 2. Confirm Environment and Network Prompts with the Agent
3. Wait for Non-Interactive Install and Tool Wiring
en.x: After completing this guide, your running external agent (OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, nanobot, Letta Code, or a cloud-hosted instance such as KimiClaw) will install the OpenMousse server on its host machine, wire tools such as board, inbox, goals, and journal into itself, and send you a one-time phone pairing link. This guide assumes you already have a machine running one of those agents. Prerequisites You are using OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, nanobot, or Letta Code on a Linux, macOS, or Windows WSL 2 machine. Your phone can install the Tailscale app and the OpenMousse app, and can sign in to the same Tailscale account as that machine (for cloud-only connector environments without a terminal, see the note under Step 2). Privacy Notes Does not replace your existing agent: OpenMousse runs alongside your existing agent as a local service and mobile frontend, forwarding your messages to it through the local OpenAI-compatible endpoint and giving it board, inbox, and memory tree tools over MCP. Secrets stay out of chat: Server tokens and API keys generated during installation are written only to local files on the machine (such as ~/.openmousse/server.json, openclaw.json, and .env). The only thing the agent sends into chat is the one-time pairing link in Step 4 (valid for 10 minutes). Asks before sensitive actions: Before using sudo to install system packages, installing Tailscale, or exposing any path to the public internet, the agent stops and asks for your approval. Steps 1. Send the Install Prompt Copy and send the following line to your running agent: Connect me to OpenMousse following https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openmousse/openmousse/main/docs/connect.md 2. Confirm Environment and Network Prompts with the Agent After reading the instructions, the agent runs each step in order and reports progress in your language. Respond to the following prompts when they appear: Install base dependencies: The machine needs Python 3.11 or later, git, and curl. If any are missing and require sudo apt install on Linux, the agent asks you first. Enable the local chat endpoint: OpenClaw: The installer automatically backs up and updates openclaw.json with no action needed from you. Hermes Agent: When modifying ~/.hermes/.env and running the install command, Hermes displays an approval prompt (valid for 5 minutes); tap Allow when you see it. nanobot / Letta Code: The agent enables its corresponding local service port automatically. Sign in to Tailscale: If Tailscale is not yet installed or signed in on the machine, the agent asks your permission, installs it, runs tailscale up, and sends you the generated sign-in URL. Open that URL in your browser and sign in with your own Tailscale account. Important: Cloud Container Limitations If your agent runs inside a container without sudo, a TUN device, or systemd (such as some cloud-hosted containers), the agent falls back to Tailscale userspace networking and starts services as background processes; those processes must be started again if the container restarts. If the container provides no terminal at all (only a settings page for adding MCP connectors), deploy OpenMousse on another machine you control. 3. Wait for Non-Interactive Install and Tool Wiring The agent passes your language, IANA time zone, and assistant name into a non-interactive install (MOUSSE_NONINTERACTIVE=1), registers OpenMousse's MCP tools (12 tools total, or 11 if the memory tree is not installed) in its own configuration, and runs bash ~/openmousse/check.sh to verify. If you are chatting with Hermes inside a chat window: Hermes cannot restart its own chat gateway from inside the gateway. Once it finishes installing and sends the pairing link, send /restart (or /reload-mcp) in the chat window so it can complete the final check.sh verification. 4. Pair on Your Phone Once the checks pass, the agent runs the pairing script and sends you a one-time pairing link (link): Install the Tailscale app on your phone and sign in to the same account used in Step 2. Install and open the OpenMousse app on your phone, then tap the pairing link from the agent. The app opens the connection screen with the server address and pairing code filled in; verify the address and tap Connect with code (the code expires after 10 minutes; if it expires, ask the agent to generate a new one). How to Verify Setup is complete when all of the following hold: Running bash ~/openmousse/check.sh on the server shows ✓ for every check. Your agent lists all 12 MCP tools under openmousse (board, inbox, goals, journal, and others). The OpenMousse phone app is connected via the pairing link, and sending a message in the app returns a reply from your agent. Next Steps Connect Your AIs to the Memory Tree: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and other external apps to the same memory tree. Install Guide for Agents: View the full command and environment variable reference read directly by external agents.

zh.d: 不部署完整的 OpenMousse，单独运行 `mousse-tree` 为外部 AI 应用同步记忆。
h: 1. 安装并初始化常驻服务
2. 选择存储方式（可选切换为 Markdown 笔记库）
3. 使用 Tailscale Funnel 开放公网路径
4. 查看接入地址并连接各平台
zh.x: 完成本指南后，你的服务器上将单独运行轻量级的世界树服务（mousse-tree），为 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、Notion、Claude Code 及 OpenClaw 提供共用的长期记忆。本指南适用于不需要部署完整 OpenMousse 客户端与多 Agent 系统、仅需跨平台统一记忆的用户。 前提条件 一台具备 Python 3.11 以上版本与 git 的 Linux、macOS 或 Windows WSL 2 机器。 若需接入 Claude 网页版、ChatGPT、Gemini 或 Notion，机器需具备公网 HTTPS 访问能力（推荐使用免费的 Tailscale Funnel）。 隐私说明 不调用模型、不产生额外模型费用：mousse-tree 仅负责记忆的存储、全文检索（FTS5 trigram）与 MCP 接口响应，本身不发起任何 LLM 调用；各平台的对话仍使用你原有的订阅。 数据留在本地：所有记忆保存在你服务器的 ~/.mousse-tree/tree.db（SQLite）或你指定的本地 Markdown 文件夹中。软链接与隐藏文件不会被收录，MCP 工具无法访问笔记文件夹以外的路径。 可审计的遗忘机制：调用 forget 删除记忆时，系统会清空正文、将空壳移入归档并删除检索索引，仅保留不含正文的 ID 与操作时间记录；若笔记文件夹开启了第三方云同步（如 iCloud、Obsidian Sync 或 git），其历史版本中可能仍留存旧内容，需在对应同步工具中清理。 步骤 1. 安装并初始化常驻服务 在服务器终端依次运行以下命令（将称呼与时区替换为你的实际信息）： pipx install "git+https://github.com/openmousse/openmousse#subdirectory=tree" mousse-tree init --name 你的称呼 --tz UTC --lang zh mousse-tree install-service 第一行也可使用 pip install --user "git+https://github.com/openmousse/openmousse#subdirectory=tree"。 install-service 会配置开机常驻服务（Linux 使用 systemd，macOS 使用 launchd），默认仅监听本机 127.0.0.1:8787。 若本机同时运行 OpenClaw，可运行 mousse-tree install-openclaw && systemctl --user restart openclaw-gateway，将世界树导出目录加入 OpenClaw 的检索路径。 2. 选择存储方式（可选切换为 Markdown 笔记库） 服务默认使用 SQLite 存储（~/.mousse-tree/tree.db）。如果你希望将每条记忆存为一篇独立的 Markdown 笔记（例如放入 Obsidian 笔记库以便在手机上查看和编辑），可运行迁移命令： mousse-tree migrate markdown --notes ~/vault/世界树 --profile-note 档案.md systemctl --user restart mousse-tree 迁移后，笔记文件成为数据源，SQLite（index.db）仅作为检索索引；你在笔记软件中直接新建或修改笔记后，服务会在 5 秒内自动同步索引。 被新记忆取代（supersedes）或你手动移入 归档/（英文为 Archive/）子目录的笔记不再参与检索。 如需切回 SQLite 存储，运行 mousse-tree migrate sqlite 并重启服务即可。 3. 使用 Tailscale Funnel 开放公网路径 云端 AI 平台需要通过公网 HTTPS 访问世界树。使用 Tailscale Funnel 仅对外暴露 /t 与 /m 两个 MCP 路径前缀： tailscale funnel --bg --set-path=/t http://127.0.0.1:8787/t tailscale funnel --bg --set-path=/m http://127.0.0.1:8787/m mousse-tree init --host <你的机器名>.<tailnet>.ts.net systemctl --user restart mousse-tree 注意：请勿公开管理页 切勿使用 Funnel 暴露 /ui 管理页路径。管理页（含记忆浏览、修改、待确认审批与档案编辑）应仅通过本机、tailscale serve（仅限局域网内设备）或 SSH 隧道访问。如需让外部平台写入的内容先进入「待确认」，可在 ~/.mousse-tree/config.json 中设置 "require_confirm": true。 4. 查看接入地址并连接各平台 在服务器终端运行以下命令，打印各平台的专属接入地址与本地管理页链接： mousse-tree urls 复制对应平台的地址，按照指南「把你常用的 AI 接进世界树」第 2、3 步的表格说明，将地址与自定义指令填入 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、Notion 或 Claude Code 中。 成功的标志 当以下各项均成立时，说明独立世界树服务已正常运行： 运行 mousse-tree stats 可正常输出当前记忆统计信息。 通过 SSH 隧道或局域网打开 mousse-tree urls 给出的 /ui#key=… 链接，可正常打开管理页并编辑个人档案。 在已接入的外部 AI 应用中写入一条新偏好后，运行 mousse-tree recent --days 7（或在 Markdown 笔记目录中）可以看到该条记录。 下一步 把你常用的 AI 接进世界树：查看各平台连接器的具体配置路径与自定义指令原文。 世界树：了解世界树的设计细节与五类记忆来源。

en.d: Run `mousse-tree` on its own to sync memory across external AI apps without deploying the full system.
h: 1. Install and initialize the background service
2. Choose a storage backend (optionally switch to a Markdown vault)
3. Expose public paths with Tailscale Funnel
4. View endpoint URLs and connect your platforms
en.x: After completing this guide, your server will run the lightweight standalone memory tree service (mousse-tree), providing a shared long-term memory for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Notion, Claude Code, and OpenClaw. This guide is for users who want unified cross-platform memory without deploying the full OpenMousse client and multi-agent system. Prerequisites A Linux, macOS, or Windows WSL 2 machine with Python 3.11 or later and git. Public HTTPS access to the machine if you want to connect Claude on the web, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Notion (free Tailscale Funnel is recommended). Privacy No model calls or extra model costs: mousse-tree only handles memory storage, full-text search (FTS5 trigram), and MCP endpoint responses. It makes no LLM calls of its own; conversations on each platform continue to use your existing subscriptions. Data stays local: All memories are stored on your server in ~/.mousse-tree/tree.db (SQLite) or in a local Markdown folder you specify. Symlinks and hidden files are ignored, and MCP tools cannot access paths outside the notes folder. Auditable forgetting: Calling forget to delete a memory clears the body, moves the empty shell to the archive, and deletes the search index entry, retaining only the bodyless ID and timestamp record. If third-party cloud sync (such as iCloud, Obsidian Sync, or git) is enabled on your notes folder, older versions may still retain the previous content and must be purged in that sync tool. Steps 1. Install and initialize the background service Run the following commands in order on your server terminal (replace the name and time zone with your own): pipx install "git+https://github.com/openmousse/openmousse#subdirectory=tree" mousse-tree init --name YourName --tz UTC --lang zh mousse-tree install-service For the first line, you can also use pip install --user "git+https://github.com/openmousse/openmousse#subdirectory=tree". install-service configures a background service that starts on boot (systemd on Linux, launchd on macOS) and listens only on 127.0.0.1:8787 by default. If OpenClaw is running on the same machine, run mousse-tree install-openclaw && systemctl --user restart openclaw-gateway to add the memory tree export directory to OpenClaw's search path. 2. Choose a storage backend (optionally switch to a Markdown vault) By default, the service stores data in SQLite (~/.mousse-tree/tree.db). If you want each memory stored as a separate Markdown note (for example, inside an Obsidian vault so you can view and edit notes on your phone), run the migration command: mousse-tree migrate markdown --notes ~/vault/世界树 --profile-note 档案.md systemctl --user restart mousse-tree After migration, the note files become the source of truth and SQLite (index.db) serves only as the search index. When you create or edit notes directly in your note-taking app, the service syncs the index automatically within 5 seconds. Notes replaced by a newer memory (supersedes) or moved manually into the 归档/ (Archive/ in English) subdirectory are excluded from search. To switch back to SQLite storage, run mousse-tree migrate sqlite and restart the service. 3. Expose public paths with Tailscale Funnel Cloud AI platforms need public HTTPS access to reach the memory tree. Use Tailscale Funnel to expose only the /t and /m MCP path prefixes: tailscale funnel --bg --set-path=/t http://127.0.0.1:8787/t tailscale funnel --bg --set-path=/m http://127.0.0.1:8787/m mousse-tree init --host <your-machine>.<tailnet>.ts.net systemctl --user restart mousse-tree Important: Do not expose the admin UI publicly Never expose the /ui admin path via Funnel. The admin page (which includes memory browsing, editing, approval of Needs your approval items, and profile editing) should only be accessed from localhost, via tailscale serve (restricted to devices on your tailnet), or over an SSH tunnel. To hold writes from external platforms in Needs your approval first, set "require_confirm": true in ~/.mousse-tree/config.json. 4. View endpoint URLs and connect your platforms Run the following command in your server terminal to print the dedicated endpoint URLs for each platform and the local admin page link: mousse-tree urls Copy the URL for each platform and follow the tables in steps 2 and 3 of "Connect Your AIs to the Memory Tree" to enter the URL and custom instructions into Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Notion, or Claude Code. Verification The standalone memory tree service is running properly when all of the following are true: Running mousse-tree stats outputs current memory statistics without error. Opening the /ui#key=… link from mousse-tree urls over an SSH tunnel or local network opens the admin page and allows you to edit your profile. After you save a new preference in a connected external AI app, running mousse-tree recent --days 7 (or checking your Markdown notes directory) shows the new entry. Next steps Connect Your AIs to the Memory Tree: View the exact connector configuration paths and custom instructions for each platform. Memory Tree: Learn about the design of the memory tree and its five memory sources.

zh.d: 在主对话中通过方案卡或在 app 内新建功能 Agent，并为它配置职责与模型。
h: 1. 选择一种方式建立功能 Agent
2. 与功能 Agent 日常协作
3. 切换看板视图管理结构化数据
zh.x: 完成本指南后，你将建立一个新的功能 Agent（例如专门整理行业报告的研究 Agent），为它设定职责与所用模型，并了解如何通过直接对话、主对话转交或召集会议与它协作。本指南假设你已部署 OpenMousse 并完成客户端配对。 前提条件 已运行 OpenMousse 服务器并配对手机或网页客户端。 服务器已配置至少一个可用的模型服务（或已接入 OpenClaw / Hermes）。 隐私说明 记忆与数据隔离：每个功能 Agent 拥有独立的对话记录、独立记忆与专属看板，与其他功能 Agent 分开存放。 共享世界树：各功能 Agent 在回答前均可查询世界树，并在得知关于你的新事实、偏好、决定或结论时写入世界树（每天 03:45 日结时也会汇总写入）。 外部应用不可见：你手动授权接入世界树的外部 AI 应用（如 Claude、ChatGPT）无法读取任何功能 Agent 的独立记忆、对话记录与看板数据。 步骤 1. 选择一种方式建立功能 Agent 代办和「学习与办公」两个 Agent 默认启用；针对健身、饮食、睡眠等其余日常领域，你可以按以下任意一种方式按需建立对应的功能 Agent（从一句话描述到试聊满意再创建的引导式新建流程 [即将推出]）： 建立方式 操作步骤 方式 A：在主对话中通过方案卡建立 1. 打开对话列表第一行的「主对话」。 2. 说明你希望新 Agent 负责的事务，例如：「帮我建一个研究 Agent，专门整理行业报告和纪要。」 3. 主对话会生成一张包含名称与职责设定的方案卡；核对无误后点击确认，系统即建立该 Agent。 方式 B：在 app 内手动填写建立 1. 在 app 的「对话」页顶部点金色 + 按钮（「新建」）→「新建 Agent」（若还不确定，也可在该页面选择「尚未确定？先讨论方案」）。 2. 依次填写该 Agent 的名称、职责说明并选择它所使用的模型，保存后即完成创建。 方式 C：批准日结后的收件箱提议 每晚 03:45 日结后，若主对话发现某类事务被你反复处理，会自动提议将其独立为一个新的功能 Agent，并生成确认卡放入收件箱与今天页的「待处理」；你点击同意后即建立该 Agent。 2. 与功能 Agent 日常协作 建立完成后，你可以通过三种路径使用该功能 Agent： 直接进入独立对话：在对话列表中点开该功能 Agent，直接向它交代任务或查阅它的独立记忆。 由主对话转交：在主对话中直接说出需求，主对话会识别事务类型并转交给对应的功能 Agent 处理。 召集多个 Agent 开短会：当一项决定涉及多个领域（例如出差期间如何同时调整研究进度、睡眠与饮食），你可以在主对话中提出（或在 app 内直接发起会议）。主对话会召集相关功能 Agent 轮流发言（每轮每个 Agent 最多发言一次，可互相 @），讨论结束后在主对话中生成一张会议纪要卡，列出决定与每条待办的负责 Agent 及时间。 注意：会议纪要须经你确认才写入数据 会议过程中各 Agent 仅作讨论，不会修改任何日程或看板数据。会议纪要卡出现在主对话中（不在今天页的「待处理」里）；只有当你点击确认后，纪要中的待办事项才会正式写入你的日程以及对应功能 Agent 的看板。你也可以补充意见并开启下一轮讨论。 3. 切换看板视图管理结构化数据 每个功能 Agent 均配有专属看板，用于维护它所负责领域的结构化记录（如文献台账、训练计划或待办事项）。进入该 Agent 的看板后，你可以按需要在五种视图之间切换：表格、看板、日历、时间线与图表。 成功的标志 当以下各项均成立时，说明新的功能 Agent 已投入工作： 新建的功能 Agent 已出现在你的对话列表中，且拥有独立的对话页与看板。 在主对话中提出属于该 Agent 职责范围的需求时，主对话能够正确转交给它，或将它召入短会参与讨论。 在主对话中点击确认会议纪要卡后，分配给该 Agent 的待办已写入它的看板中，并可在表格、看板、日历、时间线、图表五种视图间切换查看。 下一步 Agents：全面了解主对话、功能 Agent、群聊、赛博与管家的权限边界。 先问你（收件箱）：了解功能 Agent 执行操作时的三档权限与确认卡机制。 今天页与 04:00 日结：了解各功能 Agent 如何向今天页投递报告并在凌晨完成日结。

en.d: Create functional agents via proposal cards in main chat or directly in the app, and configure their roles and models.
h: 1. Choose a way to create a functional agent
2. Collaborate with a functional agent day to day
3. Switch board views to manage structured data
en.x: After completing this guide, you will have created a new functional agent (for example, a research agent dedicated to organizing industry reports), configured its role and model, and learned how to work with it through direct chat, main chat handoffs, or multi-agent meetings. This guide assumes you have deployed OpenMousse and paired a client. Prerequisites A running OpenMousse server paired with a phone or web client. At least one model provider configured on the server (or a connected OpenClaw / Hermes instance). Privacy Isolated memory and data: Each functional agent has its own chat history, dedicated memory, and dedicated board, stored separately from other functional agents. Shared memory tree: Every functional agent can query the memory tree before replying and write new facts, preferences, decisions, or conclusions about you to the memory tree as it learns them (and in summary during the daily 03:45 settlement). Invisible to external apps: External AI apps that you authorize to access the memory tree (such as Claude or ChatGPT) cannot read any functional agent's dedicated memory, chat history, or board data. Steps 1. Choose a way to create a functional agent The Errands and Study & Work agents are enabled by default. For other everyday areas such as fitness, diet, or sleep, you can create a functional agent on demand using any of the following methods (a guided creation flow from a one-line description to a test chat before creating [Coming soon]): Method Steps Method A: Via a proposal card in main chat 1. Open Main chat in the first row of the chat list. 2. Describe what you want the new agent to handle, for example: "Create a research agent to organize industry reports and meeting notes." 3. Main chat generates a proposal card with the agent's name and role definition; review it and tap confirm to create the agent. Method B: Manually in the app 1. Tap the gold + button (New) at the top of Chats → New Agent (or choose Not sure yet? Talk it through on that screen). 2. Enter the agent's name and role description, select its model, and save to finish creating it. Method C: Approve a post-settlement inbox proposal After the nightly 03:45 settlement, if main chat notices a recurring type of task you handle repeatedly, it automatically proposes spinning it off into a new functional agent and places an approval card in your inbox and To do in Today; tap approve to create the agent. 2. Collaborate with a functional agent day to day Once created, you can work with a functional agent in three ways: Chat with it directly: Open the functional agent from the chat list to assign tasks directly or inspect its dedicated memory. Hand off from main chat: State your request in main chat; main chat identifies the task type and hands it off to the corresponding functional agent. Call a short multi-agent meeting: When a decision spans multiple areas (for example, adjusting research progress, sleep, and diet during a business trip), raise it in main chat (or start a meeting directly in the app). Main chat calls the relevant functional agents to speak in turns (each agent speaks at most once per round and can @ other participants), then generates a meeting minutes card in main chat listing the decisions and the responsible agent and time for each action item. Important: Meeting minutes only write data after you confirm During a meeting, agents only discuss and do not modify any schedule or board data. The meeting minutes card appears in main chat (not under To do in Today); action items from the minutes are written to your schedule and the respective functional agents' boards only after you tap confirm. You can also add a comment to start another round of discussion. 3. Switch board views to manage structured data Every functional agent comes with a dedicated board for maintaining structured records in its domain (such as a literature log, training plan, or task list). Inside an agent's board, you can switch among five views as needed: Table, Kanban, Calendar, Timeline, and Chart. Verification Your new functional agent is ready for use when all of the following are true: The newly created functional agent appears in your chat list with its own chat screen and board. When you make a request in main chat that falls under the agent's role, main chat hands the request off to it or calls it into a short meeting. After you confirm a meeting minutes card in main chat, action items assigned to the agent are written to its board and can be viewed across the Table, Kanban, Calendar, Timeline, and Chart views. Next steps Agents: Understand the permission boundaries across main chat, functional agents, group chats, Cybers, and the Butler. Approvals (Inbox): Learn about the three-tier permission model for tool calls and how approval cards work. Today View and 04:00 Settlement: Learn how functional agents deliver reports to Today and complete the nightly settlement.

zh.d: 将事实、偏好、决定与成熟的观点存为带出处的叶子，保存在 SQLite 数据库或 Markdown 笔记库中。
zh.x: 在 OpenMousse app 中打开「设置 → 世界树」即可查看与管理；「世界树」这一行会显示当前的叶子总数（「N 片叶子」），有待确认条目时则显示「N 条待确认」。 世界树（英文界面称 memory tree）是保存在你服务器上的长期记忆。一条记忆是一片叶子，每一片叶子都带有出处，记录它来自哪一次对话、哪一天；开源版的世界树不设「枝」，叶子按来源（写入该叶子的外部平台或 Agent）归类查看。你可以随时查看、修改或删除任意一片叶子。 开源版默认将世界树存在服务器上的 SQLite 数据库中；你也可以将其配置为一条一篇 Markdown 笔记，放进你的笔记库（例如与 Obsidian 同步的文件夹）。安装时若指定了笔记库路径会直接按 Markdown 存储，后续也可以使用 mousse-tree migrate 切换存储方式。 在记忆页 [即将推出] 中，年轮外圈是今天，往里是前几天；一个点代表一条新记忆，琥珀点停在环外代表「待确认」。开启「待确认」开关后（该开关目前默认关闭），拿不准的记忆会先进「待确认」，经你确认后才正式写入世界树。此外，系统支持每周日提议合并或删除重复的叶子并交由你逐条确认 [即将推出]。 Agent 如何使用世界树 主对话与功能 Agent：在平时对话中，当它们得知关于你的新事实、偏好、决定或近况时，会将其写进世界树，并在回答你的问题前先查询世界树。 03:45 日结与 04:00 会话重置：每天 03:45 日结时，各 Agent 会把当天的结论与新知道的关于你的事写进各自记忆和世界树；04:00 会话重置，当天的对话按天归档。 赛博 [即将推出]：赛博通过其装载的功能 Agent 读取世界树；若要将内容写进世界树，须先生成一张确认卡（或进入「待确认」），经你确认后才写入。 接入的外部 AI 应用：通过 MCP 接入的 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、Notion 与 Claude Code 在回答前调用 profile 和 recall 读取世界树，并在得知新信息时调用 remember 写回世界树。 存什么 世界树只存关于你的事：你的事实、偏好、决定、近况与成熟的观点。它们来自五个渠道： 其他 AI：你在 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等外部应用对话中谈及的个人事实、偏好与决定（或初次使用时把它们记得的关于你的事贴进主对话写进世界树的记忆）。 日常结论：从健康、日程、邮件中得出的关于你的结论（例如「最近睡得少」）。 工作与学习复述：学习时你用自己的话复述的要点与你的观点。 Zen 中成熟的观点：在 Zen 里经过「讨论 → 完成 → 保存到库」整理后，值得长期记住的观点。 朋友讨论：与朋友的讨论或一起录制的播客中提炼出的关于你的观点与决定。 不在这里的东西 以下数据虽然也保存在你的服务器上（或留在原处），但不会写进世界树，外部接入的 AI 应用也无法通过世界树读取它们： 原始健康、日程、邮件与文件数据：Apple 健康的睡眠、心率、训练明细，以及原始日程表、邮件和文件，由对应的功能 Agent 直接读取，本身不是世界树的叶子。 学习时阅读的原文：课程、文件与阅读材料的原文进入「学习与办公 Agent」的资料库，不进世界树。 Zen 里未存进库的想法：在 Zen 中随手记下的想法，或聊天时点击「只记下」的内容，只存为本地 Markdown 笔记，不发给模型，也不会在凌晨日结时自动写进世界树。 外部 AI 平台的完整对话记录：接入世界树的外部 AI 只把关于你的事写入世界树，完整的聊天上下文仍留在各家平台上。 各功能 Agent 的独立记忆与对话记录：每个功能 Agent 拥有自己的对话、看板与独立记忆，与世界树分开存放。 管家的可见范围：管家对外回答好友询问时，完全看不到世界树，只看你按关系档位明确放出的日程、近况、分享过的内容、学习笔记或住址。 另见 把你常用的 AI 接进世界树：获取 MCP 专属地址并配置外部 AI 应用。 Agents：了解主对话、功能 Agent、赛博与管家的权限分工。 Zen：了解想法如何经过推敲并存入世界树。 数据与安全：了解服务器数据存储与隐私边界。

en.d: Store facts, preferences, decisions, and distilled opinions as provenance-tracked leaves in SQLite or a Markdown vault.
h: How agents use the memory tree
en.x: Open Settings → Memory tree in the OpenMousse app to view and manage your memories; the Memory tree row displays the current leaf count ("N leaves"), or "N Needs your approval" when items are waiting for review. The memory tree is your long-term memory stored on your server. Each memory is a leaf with provenance recording which conversation and which day it came from. The open-source memory tree does not use branches; leaves are grouped by source (the external platform or agent that wrote the leaf). You can view, edit, or delete any leaf at any time. By default, the open-source edition stores the memory tree in a SQLite database on your server. You can also configure it to store one Markdown note per leaf inside your note vault (for example, a folder synced with Obsidian). If you specify a vault path during installation, it uses Markdown storage right away; you can also switch storage backends later using mousse-tree migrate. On the Memory screen [Coming soon], the outer tree ring represents today and inner rings represent previous days; each dot represents a new memory, and amber dots resting outside the ring represent Needs your approval. When the Needs your approval toggle is enabled (off by default), uncertain memories go to Needs your approval first and are written to the memory tree only after you confirm them. In addition, the system can propose merging or deleting duplicate leaves every Sunday for you to confirm one by one [Coming soon]. How agents use the memory tree Main chat and functional agents: During everyday conversations, when they learn new facts, preferences, decisions, or recent updates about you, they write them to the memory tree, and they query the memory tree before answering your questions. 03:45 settlement and 04:00 session reset: During the daily 03:45 settlement, each agent writes the day's conclusions and newly learned facts about you to its own memory and to the memory tree; at 04:00, sessions reset and the day's conversations are archived by day. Cybers [Coming soon]: A Cyber reads the memory tree through its mounted functional agents; to write to the memory tree, it must first generate an approval card (or send the entry to Needs your approval) and wait for your confirmation. Connected external AI apps: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Notion, and Claude Code connected over MCP call profile and recall to read the memory tree before replying, and call remember to write back to the memory tree when they learn new information about you. What goes in The memory tree stores only things about you: your facts, preferences, decisions, recent status, and distilled opinions. They come from five channels: Other AIs: Personal facts, preferences, and decisions you mention in conversations with external apps such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini (or memories about you exported from those apps and pasted into main chat during initial setup). Daily conclusions: Conclusions about you drawn from your health, schedule, and email data (for example, "has been sleeping less recently"). Work and study recaps: Key points restated in your own words and your own takeaways while studying. Distilled opinions from Zen: Opinions worth remembering long term after you refine them in Zen through Discuss → Done → Save to the vault. Discussions with friends: Your own opinions and decisions distilled from discussions or podcasts recorded with friends. What stays out The following data is also stored on your server (or remains in its original location), but is not written to the memory tree and cannot be read through the memory tree by connected external AI apps: Raw health, schedule, email, and file data: Detailed Apple Health sleep, heart rate, and workout records, as well as raw calendars, emails, and files, are read directly by the corresponding functional agents and are not leaves in the memory tree. Source texts read during study: The full text of courses, documents, and reading materials goes into the Study & Work agent's library, not the memory tree. Unsaved thoughts in Zen: Quick thoughts jotted down in Zen, or notes saved by tapping private note during a discussion, are stored only as local Markdown notes; they are not sent to models and are not automatically written to the memory tree during the nightly settlement. Full chat logs from external AI platforms: External AIs connected to the memory tree write only facts about you to the memory tree; full conversation transcripts remain on each platform. Dedicated memories and chat histories of functional agents: Each functional agent has its own chat, board, and dedicated memory stored separately from the memory tree. What the Butler can see: When answering inquiries from friends on your behalf, the Butler cannot see the memory tree at all; it sees only the schedule, recent status, shared items, study notes, or address that you explicitly expose for that relationship tier. See also Connect Your AIs to the Memory Tree: Get your dedicated MCP URLs and configure external AI apps. Agents: Learn how permissions are divided among main chat, functional agents, Cybers, and the Butler. Zen: Learn how thoughts are refined and saved to the memory tree. Data and Security: Learn where server data is stored and how privacy boundaries are enforced.

zh.d: 了解主对话、功能 Agent、会议纪要、群聊、赛博与管家的分工和边界。
zh.x: 在 OpenMousse app 的对话列表中即可查看并进入所有 Agent；列表第一行固定为主对话，其余为各功能 Agent、赛博与群聊。 OpenMousse 将日常事务、长期思考与对外沟通分给不同角色的 Agent 处理。你可以在主对话中交代需求，由主对话转交给对应的功能 Agent 或召集会议；也可以直接点进任意一个功能 Agent 的对话、看板与独立记忆页面与它沟通。 各类角色与分工 主对话：系统的总入口。负责接收你的日常交办、读写世界树、向功能 Agent 分派任务，以及发起并主持多 Agent 会议。每晚日结后，主对话也可能把你反复处理的事务提议为新的功能 Agent，生成方案卡放入收件箱等你确认。 功能 Agent：每个功能 Agent 只负责一类事，其中代办 Agent、学习与办公 Agent 默认启用，健身 Agent、饮食 Agent、睡眠 Agent 以及其他领域的 Agent（例如研究 Agent）可按需新建。每个功能 Agent 拥有独立的对话、记忆、工具与看板；看板集合支持五种视图：表格、看板、日历、时间线、图表。 赛博 [即将推出]：拥有独立的性格、记忆与模型，在特定方向上长期辅助你思考（例如一位追问到底的质疑者或一位学习教练）。它的资料页是一张证件，仅包含身份、记忆、装载三项。赛博不直接访问你的数据，查资料或改动数据均交由其「装载的功能 Agent」处理：只读结果直接返回，修改数据则生成确认卡，要写进世界树也须先生成确认卡（或进入「待确认」）经你确认。 管家 [即将推出]：对外代表你，按亲近、朋友、同学三档关系回答好友及好友 agent 的询问（例如核对周四晚上是否有空）。管家仅读取你按该档位开放的日程、近况、分享过的内容、学习笔记或住址，看不到世界树与健康数据。涉及时间、金钱、承诺的事项，管家一律回答「这个得（你的名字）本人定，我去问一下。」并生成确认卡交给你；每一句对外回复在发出前均经 Doorman 复查。 会议、纪要与群聊 会议与纪要：遇到需要跨领域协同的事，可由主对话发起并主持短会，你也可以在 app 内自己发起。会上几个 Agent 轮流发言，每轮每个 Agent 最多发言一次，并可 @ 其他成员；会上只讨论，不改动任何数据。一轮结束后，主对话出具一张会议纪要卡（包含决定与待办，每条待办标明负责的 Agent 与时间），出现在主对话中。经你确认后，待办才会写入日程与对应 Agent 的看板；你也可以补一句开启下一轮。 群聊：几个 Agent（包括赛博）在一个群内讨论，你 @ 谁谁回答，不生成会议纪要。会议结束后也可以保留为群聊。 不在这里的东西 没有日程 Agent 与朋友 Agent：日程由主对话与各功能 Agent 共用并写入今天页；好友互动与对外回复由「好友」功能及「管家」负责。 没有跨用户的 Agent 模板库：功能 Agent 均在你的服务器上通过主对话方案卡或 app 内表单按需建立。 管家不理会陌生人，也不自决承诺：只有互为好友的联系人能向管家提问；管家回复使用不带任何工具的模型调用，不能自行答应约会或索取请求。 另见 建立并管理功能 Agent：了解通过主对话方案卡或 app 表单新建功能 Agent 的步骤。 世界树：了解各角色读写长期记忆的权限边界。 先问你（收件箱）：了解确认卡的生成与审批机制。

en.d: Understand the roles and boundaries of main chat, functional agents, meeting minutes, group chats, Cybers, and the Butler.
en.x: You can view and open all agents from the chat list in the OpenMousse app; the first row is always main chat, followed by your functional agents, Cybers, and group chats. OpenMousse divides everyday tasks, long-term thinking, and external communication across agents with distinct roles. You can state a request in main chat and let main chat hand it off to the appropriate functional agent or call a meeting, or you can open any functional agent's chat, board, and dedicated memory directly. Roles and responsibilities Main chat: The primary entry point to the system. It receives your everyday requests, reads and writes the memory tree, dispatches tasks to functional agents, and calls and moderates multi-agent meetings. After the nightly settlement, main chat may also propose turning a recurring task into a new functional agent by placing a proposal card in your inbox for confirmation. Functional agents: Each functional agent handles a single domain. The Errands agent and the Study & Work agent are enabled by default; fitness, diet, sleep, and other domain agents (such as a research agent) can be created as needed. Each functional agent has its own chat, memory, tools, and board; board collections support five views: Table, Kanban, Calendar, Timeline, and Chart. Cybers [Coming soon]: Long-term thinking partners with their own persona, memory, and model for a specific direction (such as a relentless questioner or a study coach). A Cyber's profile page is an ID card containing only three sections: identity, memory, and mounted agents. A Cyber does not access your data directly; any data lookup or modification is handled by its mounted functional agents: read-only results are returned directly, data modifications generate an approval card, and writing to the memory tree also requires generating an approval card (or sending the entry to Needs your approval) for your confirmation. The Butler [Coming soon]: Represents you externally, answering inquiries from friends and your friends' agents according to three relationship tiers: close, friend, and classmate (for example, checking whether you are free Thursday evening). The Butler reads only the schedule, recent status, shared items, study notes, or address that you open to that tier, and has no access to the memory tree or health data. For anything involving time, money, or commitments, the Butler always replies, "That's up to (your name) personally—let me ask." and generates an approval card for you; every outbound reply is reviewed by Doorman before it is sent. Meetings, minutes, and group chats Meetings and minutes: When a matter requires coordination across domains, main chat can call and moderate a short meeting, or you can start one yourself in the app. Participating agents speak in turns, at most once per round, and can @ other members; during the meeting they only discuss and do not modify any data. At the end of a round, main chat produces a meeting minutes card (containing decisions and action items, with each action item specifying the responsible agent and time) directly in main chat. Action items are written to your schedule and the respective agents' boards only after you confirm; you can also add a note to start the next round. Group chats: Several agents (including Cybers) discuss in a single group where whichever agent you @ replies, without generating meeting minutes. A meeting can also be kept as a group chat after it ends. What stays out No Schedule agent or Friends agent: Your schedule is shared across main chat and functional agents and displayed in Today; friend interactions and external replies are handled by Friends and the Butler. No cross-user agent template store: Functional agents are created on demand on your own server via a proposal card in main chat or an in-app form. The Butler ignores strangers and makes no commitments on its own: Only mutual friends can ask the Butler questions; Butler replies use a tool-free model call and cannot accept appointments or requests on your behalf. See also Create and Manage Functional Agents: Learn the steps for creating a functional agent via a proposal card in main chat or the in-app form. Memory Tree: Learn the permission boundaries for reading and writing long-term memory across roles. Approvals (Inbox): Learn how approval cards are generated and reviewed.

zh.d: 查看待处理、日程与报告，了解 03:45 日结与 04:00 会话重置的运作机制。
zh.x: 打开 OpenMousse app，在底栏第三格「今天」即可查看「今天页」；每天 03:45 的日结与 04:00 的会话重置由服务器在后台自动执行。 OpenMousse 的一天从 04:00 开始计算。今天页将当天需要你动手审批的事项、需要你到场的日程，以及各功能 Agent 送来的报告汇总在一处；凌晨则自动完成前一日的结论沉淀与对话归档。 今天页的构成 今天页自上而下分为三个常驻板块（早上 05:30–13:00 期间，日视图最上方还会单独展示一张起床卡，即起床报告）： 待处理：需要你动手处理的事项。包括等你批准的确认卡、标签为「安全」的安全提醒（例如好友那边发来的话里夹着指令，或 Doorman 扣下的管家回复），以及快到期的待办和截止事项。 日程：当天需要你到场的安排。 报告：各功能 Agent 整理好送来供你阅读的信息。例如睡眠 Agent 生成的睡眠卡，记录昨晚睡了多久、恢复分，以及近 6 天的恢复分走势。 03:45 日结与 04:00 会话重置 系统按你的时区在每天凌晨执行以下两步操作： 03:45 日结：主对话与各功能 Agent 回顾过去一天的对话与数据，把当天的结论以及新得知的关于你的事实、偏好、决定与近况，分别写进各自的独立记忆与世界树。如果主对话发现某件事务被你反复交办，也会在日结后提议新建一个功能 Agent，放进收件箱等你同意。 04:00 会话重置：当天的对话按天归档。聊天记录按天翻阅，每一天的分界线均为 04:00。 提示：起床卡的显示时段 起床卡（起床报告）仅在每天 05:30–13:00 出现在日视图最上方，不归入下方的「报告」板块中。 不在这里的东西 会议纪要卡不在「待处理」中：多 Agent 短会结束后，会议纪要卡直接出现在「主对话」里（提供「确认」与「查看会议」操作），不会进入今天页的「待处理」。 Zen 里未存进库的想法不参与 03:45 日结：你在 Zen 中随手记下的想法，或推敲时点击「只记下」的内容，仅保存为本地 Markdown 笔记，不会在 03:45 日结时自动写入世界树或任何 Agent 的记忆。 另见 先问你（收件箱）：了解确认卡与安全提醒的产生条件及处理方式。 世界树：了解 03:45 日结写入世界树的内容范围。 Agents：了解各功能 Agent 的日常职责与会议纪要流程。

en.d: Explore To do, Schedule, and Reports in the Today view, along with the 03:45 daily settlement and 04:00 session reset.
en.x: Open the OpenMousse app to view Today in the third tab of the bottom bar; the daily 03:45 settlement and 04:00 session reset run automatically in the background on your server. A day in OpenMousse starts at 04:00. Today brings together items waiting for your approval, scheduled events you need to attend, and reports delivered by your functional agents; overnight, the system automatically distills the previous day's conclusions and archives the day's conversations. Structure of the Today view From top to bottom, Today is divided into three permanent sections (between 05:30 and 13:00, a wake-up card—your morning briefing—is also displayed at the very top of the day view): To do: Items that require action from you. This includes approval cards waiting for your approval, security alerts tagged Security (for example, a message from a friend's side carrying embedded instructions, or a Butler reply held back by Doorman), and upcoming tasks and deadlines. Schedule: Events you need to attend that day. Reports: Information compiled and delivered for your reading by functional agents—for example, a sleep card generated by the sleep agent showing how long you slept last night, your recovery score, and your 6-day recovery trend. 03:45 settlement and 04:00 session reset Every night, according to your time zone, the system performs two steps: 03:45 settlement: Main chat and each functional agent review the past day's conversations and data, writing the day's conclusions along with newly learned facts, preferences, decisions, and recent updates about you into their respective dedicated memories and the memory tree. If main chat notices a task you have assigned repeatedly, it also proposes creating a new functional agent after settlement and places the proposal in your inbox for approval. 04:00 session reset: The day's conversations are archived by day. Chat history is browsed by day, with 04:00 as the boundary between days. Note: When the wake-up card appears The wake-up card (morning briefing) appears at the very top of the day view only between 05:30 and 13:00 each day and is not grouped under the Reports section below. What stays out Meeting minutes cards do not appear in To do: After a short multi-agent meeting ends, the meeting minutes card appears directly in Main chat (with Confirm and Open actions) and does not go into To do in Today. Unsaved thoughts in Zen are excluded from the 03:45 settlement: Quick thoughts jotted down in Zen, or notes saved by tapping private note while refining an idea, are stored only as local Markdown notes and are not automatically written to the memory tree or any agent's memory during the 03:45 settlement. See also Approvals (Inbox): Learn when approval cards and security alerts are generated and how to handle them. Memory Tree: Learn what the 03:45 settlement writes to the memory tree. Agents: Learn the everyday roles of functional agents and how meeting minutes work.

zh.d: 付款、对外发送、提交与登录等撤不回的操作先生成确认卡并锁定参数，等你批准后再执行。
h: 确认卡的来源与处理流程
zh.x: 在 OpenMousse app 的「今天 → 待处理」、对应对话消息的下方，或手机系统通知中均可查看并处理确认卡。 为了防止 Agent 在未经你同意的情况下对外发信、付款或改动关键数据，OpenMousse 对所有工具调用实行分级管控。凡属撤不回的操作，Agent 一律先停下来生成一张锁定参数的确认卡，交由你批准后才执行。 工具调用三档机制 系统内核将 Agent 的工具调用分为三档 [即将推出]： 只读操作：查询世界树、读取日程或查看看板等不改动数据的操作，由 Agent 直接执行。 撤得回的操作：在内部新增或修改记录等可逆操作，由 Agent 直接执行，并在该条回复下方附带一个改动编号；你只需回复「撤销」，系统即可将该次改动恢复原状。 撤不回的操作：付款、对外发送、提交表单、账号登录等操作，一律停下来生成确认卡，锁定调用参数；经你点击批准后，系统严格照原参数执行一次。 确认卡的来源与处理流程 除第三档工具调用外，以下场景也会在收件箱与「今天 → 待处理」中生成确认卡或提醒： 代办 Agent 的外部操作：代办 Agent 在隔离沙箱中比价、填表后，涉及提交、发送、登录或付款时生成确认卡。 管家的对外承诺与 Doorman 复查：好友或好友的管家找你约时间、要东西时，管家不会自行答应，而是生成确认卡交给你定；管家发出的每一句回复若被 Doorman 判定不妥，也会扣下并交由你决定照发、修改或不发。 赛博的数据修改与世界树写入 [即将推出]：赛博通过其装载的功能 Agent 请求修改数据，或请求将内容写入世界树时，均会生成确认卡等你确认。 新建或提议功能 Agent：每晚日结后，主对话提议将你反复做的事建为新 Agent 时，会放进收件箱等你同意。 外来指令安全提醒：当好友那边发来的消息里夹着试图操纵系统的指令时，系统会在「今天 → 待处理」中生成标签为「安全」的提醒。 你在任意一处（今天页待处理、对话消息下方或通知）批准或拒绝后，该确认卡即处理完毕，并在原处收起为一行回执。 不在这里的东西 会议纪要不在收件箱中审批：多 Agent 短会的纪要卡直接出现在主对话中，经你在主对话内点击确认后写入日程与各 Agent 看板。 世界树的「待确认」叶子不在收件箱中：开启世界树的「待确认」开关后，系统拿不准的记忆会停在「设置 → 世界树」（或记忆页年轮环外）的「待确认」列表中，不混入收件箱的确认卡。 另见 代办与 Doorman：了解代办沙箱与 Doorman 如何配合确认卡管控出网请求。 今天页与 04:00 日结：了解「待处理」板块与安全提醒的日常展示。 内核（agent harness） [即将推出]：了解发言方权限分档与工具三档的底层实现。

en.d: Hold irreversible actions like payments, external messages, submissions, and logins in parameter-locked approval cards until you approve.
h: Where approval cards come from and how they are handled
en.x: You can view and act on approval cards in Today → To do in the OpenMousse app, directly beneath the corresponding chat message, or from system notifications on your phone. To prevent agents from sending external messages, making payments, or modifying critical data without your consent, OpenMousse enforces tiered control over all tool calls. Whenever an action is irreversible, the agent stops and generates an approval card with locked parameters, executing it only after you approve. Three-tier tool execution The system engine divides agent tool calls into three tiers [Coming soon]: Read-only actions: Operations that do not modify data—such as querying the memory tree, reading your schedule, or viewing a board—are executed directly by the agent. Reversible actions: Reversible internal operations—such as adding or updating a record—are executed directly by the agent, with a change ID attached beneath the reply; reply Undo to restore the state prior to that change. Irreversible actions: Operations such as payments, outbound messages, form submissions, and account logins always pause and generate an approval card that locks the call parameters; once you tap approve, the system executes the call exactly once with those locked parameters. Where approval cards come from and how they are handled In addition to third-tier tool calls, the following scenarios also generate approval cards or alerts in your inbox and Today → To do: External actions by the Errands agent: After the Errands agent compares prices or fills out forms inside its isolated sandbox, any step involving submitting, sending, logging in, or paying generates an approval card. External commitments by the Butler and Doorman review: When a friend or a friend's Butler asks to schedule time or request something from you, the Butler does not agree on its own, but instead generates an approval card for you to decide; if any outbound reply from the Butler is flagged by Doorman, it is also held back for you to send as-is, edit, or discard. Data modifications and memory tree writes by Cybers [Coming soon]: When a Cyber requests to modify data through one of its mounted functional agents or requests to write to the memory tree, it generates an approval card for your confirmation. Creating or proposing a functional agent: When main chat proposes spinning off a recurring task into a new agent after the nightly settlement, the proposal is placed in your inbox for approval. Security alerts for external instructions: When an incoming message from a friend's side contains instructions attempting to manipulate the system, the system generates an alert tagged Security in Today → To do. Once you approve or reject an approval card in any location (To do in Today, beneath the chat message, or in a notification), the card is resolved and collapses into a single-line receipt in place. What stays out Meeting minutes are not approved in the inbox: Meeting minutes cards from short multi-agent meetings appear directly in main chat and are written to your schedule and agents' boards when you tap confirm inside main chat. Memory tree leaves in Needs your approval are not in the inbox: When the Needs your approval toggle is enabled for the memory tree, uncertain memories wait in the Needs your approval list under Settings → Memory tree (or outside the tree ring on the Memory screen) and are not mixed into inbox approval cards. See also Errands and Doorman: Learn how the Errands sandbox and Doorman work with approval cards to govern outbound requests. Today View and 04:00 Settlement: Learn how the To do section and security alerts are displayed day to day. Engine (Agent Harness) [Coming soon]: Learn the underlying implementation of speaker permission tiers and three-tier tool execution.

zh.d: 先把想法记下而不触发回复，准备好后再与 AI 推敲，将成熟的观点写入世界树。
zh.x: 在 OpenMousse app 底栏打开第二格「Zen」（底栏依次为「对话 / Zen / 今天 / 目标」）即可记录想法与展开推敲。 Zen 是先把想法放下的地方。一篇刚读完的文章、一段印象深刻的视频，或一闪而过的念头，都可以先存入 Zen。存入不会触发回复，AI 不会介入；等你准备好之后，再挑出相关内容与 AI 一起推敲，将成熟的观点写入世界树，在之后的决策里发挥作用。 如何使用 Zen Zen 的使用分为四个步骤，每一步是否让 AI 介入均由你决定： 记下想法（只存不发）：随手记下的想法以 Markdown 笔记的形式保存在你的服务器或你的笔记库中。此时内容只存不发——不会发给模型，不会进入任何 Agent 的记忆，也不会在凌晨 03:45 日结时自动写入世界树。 「讨论」与「只记下」：当你准备好推敲时，挑出几条想法点击「讨论」，即可与 AI 一起梳理和讨论。在聊的过程中，如果你临时想到一句话但不想让 AI 接着往下接，可以点击「只记下」：这句话只保存在笔记里，不发给 AI 看。 完成：讨论告一段落时，点击「完成」，AI 会将这次思考的过程与结论整理成一份笔记草稿供你审阅和修改。 保存到库：你改好草稿后点击「保存到库」。其中值得长期记住的成熟观点会写成世界树的叶子，需要执行的待办事项则会加进你的日程。 提示：Zen 的隐私与模型调用边界 只要你不点击「讨论」，你在 Zen 里写下的任何文字都只留在你的服务器本地（或你的同步笔记库中），不会产生任何发往模型服务的请求。 不在这里的东西 未经「保存到库」的内容不进世界树：在主对话或功能 Agent 对话中说出的个人偏好与决定，会被直接（或在 03:45 日结时）写进世界树；但在 Zen 中，只有走完「讨论 → 完成 → 保存到库」这一步的内容，才会写入世界树与日程。 不是任务看板或资料原文库：长期跟踪的项目表格与日历存放在各功能 Agent 的看板中；课程、文件与阅读材料的原文则存放在「学习与办公 Agent」的资料库中。 另见 世界树：了解「保存到库」后的成熟观点如何作为世界树的叶子被其他 Agent 调取。 今天页与 04:00 日结：了解存进库的待办事项如何在日程中展示，以及 03:45 日结的排除范围。

en.d: Capture thoughts without triggering AI replies, refine them when ready, and save distilled opinions to the memory tree.
en.x: Open Zen from the second tab of the bottom bar in the OpenMousse app (Chats / Zen / Today / Goals) to jot down thoughts and refine them. Zen is a place to set thoughts down first. An article you just finished, a video that stood out, or a passing idea can all go into Zen first. Saving a note does not trigger a reply and the AI does not step in; when you are ready, pick out related notes to refine with the AI and save distilled opinions to the memory tree so they can inform future decisions. How to use Zen Using Zen follows four steps, and at every step you decide whether the AI is involved: Capture thoughts (saved without sending): Thoughts you jot down are saved as Markdown notes on your server or in your note vault. At this stage, content is saved without being sent—it is not sent to any model, does not enter any agent's memory, and is not automatically written to the memory tree during the 03:45 settlement. Discuss and private note: When you are ready to think something through, select a few notes and tap Discuss to organize and discuss them with the AI. During the discussion, if a thought occurs to you that you do not want the AI to respond to, tap private note: the line is saved only in the note and is not shown to the AI. Done: When the discussion wraps up, tap Done and the AI compiles the thinking process and conclusions into a draft note for you to review and edit.
